description: Frames per preset and format: one valid frame, each wrong length (off by one either way), a pal16 byte of 16 and of 255, a hex g; plus the grid boundaries 1x1, 256x1, 1x256 and 256x256 (pal16 up to 65,538 bytes, hex up to 65,793). expect is decode's result: cells and seq, or the drop reason. Tag choice marks this kit's reading where the spec is silent (README.md).
